C1281.title: Shanghai Police Crack Down on AI-Powered Article Spinning Harming Business Interests
C1281.summary: In May 2025, Shanghai police disclosed an AI-assisted rumor case. Yao hired Lu to generate false articles about a tea beverage company and published them through more than ten self-media accounts; daily revenue at stores in some regions fell by over 20% year on year. Chen also rewrote online rumors with AI to promote training courses. Police arrested eight suspects in March and imposed compulsory criminal measures.
